mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `rag_knowledge` (`id`, `content`, `create_time`) VALUES (#{id}, #{content}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `content` = VALUES(`content`), `create_time` = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS score FROM `rag_knowledge` WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
